\begin{lemma}[Factorization of an independent product moment]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.integral_abs_mul_pow}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.integral_abs_mul_pow}
\leanok
\difficulty{2}
Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, let $U,V:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ be measurable up
to null sets, and suppose $U$ and $V$ are independent under $\mu$. For every natural
number $p$, the integral of $|UV|^p$ equals the product of the integrals of $|U|^p$ and
$|V|^p$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}[Single-coordinate replacement bound]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.single_coordinate_replacement_bound_c3}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.single_coordinate_replacement_bound_c3}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.coordinateDerivative, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.coordinateFree, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.coordinate_abs_third_moment, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.coordinate_parts_eq_of_off_coordinate, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.eval_coordinate_split, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.indep_coordinate_parts, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.integral_abs_mul_pow, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.independent_affine_replacement_bound_c3, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.integrable_test_of_memLp, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsHypercontractive, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.evalMultilinearRV, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.evalMultilinearRV_memLp_nat, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial.HasDegreeAtMost, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial.eval, BooleanAnalysis.influence}
\difficulty{5}
Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, let $F$ be a multilinear polynomial on the
Boolean cube of dimension $n$ with degree at most $k$, and fix a coordinate $i$. Suppose
$X_1,\ldots,X_n$ are mutually independent random variables on this space, and likewise
$Y_1,\ldots,Y_n$ are mutually independent. Let $0<\rho<1$, and assume every $X_j$ and
$Y_j$ is $(2,3,\rho)$-hypercontractive, has mean zero, and has second moment one.
Suppose also that $X_j=Y_j$ for every $j\ne i$. If $\psi:\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ is three
times continuously differentiable and $|\psi'''(t)|\le C$ for every $t\in\mathbb R$,
where $C\ge0$, then
\[\left|\mathbb E\bigl[\psi(F(X))\bigr]-\mathbb E\bigl[\psi(F(Y))\bigr]\right|\le \frac{C}{3}\left(\frac1\rho\right)^{3k}\mathrm{Inf}_i[F]^{3/2},\]
where $F(X)$ and $F(Y)$ denote the polynomial evaluated on the respective random inputs,
and $\mathrm{Inf}_i[F]$ is the influence of the restriction of $F$ to Boolean sign
inputs.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Third-derivative invariance bound]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.invariance_c3_of_independent_pair}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.invariance_c3_of_independent_pair}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.hybridIndex, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.hybridIndex_injective, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.hybridInput, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.hybridInput_succ_off, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.hybrid_expectation_bound, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.Invariance.single_coordinate_replacement_bound_c3, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsHypercontractive, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.evalMultilinearRV, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial.HasDegreeAtMost, BooleanAnalysis.ThresholdFunctions.MultilinearPolynomial.eval, BooleanAnalysis.influence}
\difficulty{4}
Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a probability space, and let $F$ be a
multilinear coefficient family on $n$ coordinates of degree at most $k$. Suppose the
$2n$ real random variables $Z_{L,i},Z_{R,i}$ are mutually independent, each is
$(2,3,\rho)$-hypercontractive for some $0<\rho<1$, and each has mean $0$ and second
moment $1$. If $\psi\in C^3(\mathbb R)$ and $C\ge0$ bounds $|\psi'''|$ everywhere, then
\[
\left|\mathbb E_\mu\psi(F(Z_L))-\mathbb E_\mu\psi(F(Z_R))\right|\le \frac
C3\left(\frac1\rho\right)^{3k}\sum_{i=1}^n \mathrm{Inf}_i[F]^{{3}/{2}},
\]
where $F(Z)(\omega)=\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}F(S)\prod_{i\in S}Z_i(\omega)$ and
$\mathrm{Inf}_i[F]$ is the influence of the Walsh-basis function defined by the same
coefficients.
\end{theorem}
